caption: Full-release and primary metadata probes use different source compositions. Both combined metadata probes attain AUROC 1.0000: matching native dimensions alone does not remove quantization-table leakage. Counts include all release files; ROC uses held-out grouped test sets. Descriptive comparisons: JPEG encoding is origin-aligned; subjects are unverified. No confirmed origin effect.

Contour heights are within-cell KDE levels (15%, 40%, 70% of the peak), not between-cell counts. Centroid ellipses use 500 source-group bootstrap resamples and Gaussian 95% contours. Shared axes; arrows are signed descriptive displacements. The historical filename does not establish causality. Descriptive comparisons: JPEG encoding is origin-aligned; subjects are unverified. No confirmed origin effect.

PCA points: 6,000 held-out artworks; arrows use a common display multiplier on loadings. t-SNE: fixed 3,000-artwork subset, 150 per style/origin; symbols encode styles and colors origins. Lines span five random-initialization seeds; whiskers show seed ranges, not confidence intervals. t-SNE distances are exploratory and are not used for inference. Descriptive comparisons: JPEG encoding is origin-aligned; subjects are unverified. No confirmed origin effect.

Artwork statistics are medians over four 128² quadrants; shaded bands and whiskers are 95% source-group bootstrap intervals (1,000 resamples). Human/LD use native256; SD is a separate resized768→256 sensitivity, not a controlled counterpart. Haar LH denotes row-highpass response (horizontal edges); LL2 is retained in the denominator. Descriptive comparisons: JPEG encoding is origin-aligned; subjects are unverified. No confirmed origin effect.

Each family cell averages its prespecified measurements after frozen development RobustScaler normalization. * means at least one constituent feature passes the exploratory BH-adjusted group-randomization + split-half-null rule; it is not a family-level test or confirmed drift. Feature-level values, pass counts and signed-shift CIs are in style_feature_drift.csv. Zero confirmatory cells. Descriptive comparisons: JPEG encoding is origin-aligned; subjects are unverified. No confirmed origin effect.

The six measurements were selected by absolute coefficients of the frozen development-trained handcrafted probe, without test ranking. Each violin, jitter cloud and ECDF shows one supported historical style (300 artworks per origin); Cubism is absent from this release. KS D is descriptive. Values use raw measurement units; statistical-table distances use development scaling. Descriptive comparisons: JPEG encoding is origin-aligned; subjects are unverified. No confirmed origin effect.

All five probes share the same 6,000 Human/LD test IDs; regularization and thresholds were fixed on development/validation. Whiskers: 1,000 within-origin source-group bootstrap 95% intervals conditional on frozen fits. ARI uses unlabeled NumPy Lloyd k-means (20 seeded starts); clustering is fitted separately within each style and compared with labels afterward. Descriptive comparisons: JPEG encoding is origin-aligned; subjects are unverified. No confirmed origin effect.

Changes are variant minus all-family four-quadrant baseline. Horizontal intervals: 1,000 paired source-group bootstrap draws; silhouette intervals condition on cached per-artwork scores in each fixed geometry. Saturation boundaries use development data only. Full-canvas vectors have no across-crop IQR features; five-crop includes center overlap. See ablation_results.csv for F1, ties and complete paired intervals. Descriptive comparisons: JPEG encoding is origin-aligned; subjects are unverified. No confirmed origin effect.

Both origins undergo identical held-out transformations; original JPEG is the Q=100 reference, not a Q100 re-encode. AUROC whiskers: 1,000 source-group bootstrap 95% intervals, fixed probe and thresholds. Silhouette uses transformed features and frozen scaling. W₁ ranking averages all 104 prespecified standardized measurements within style; ρ spans ten styles. Resize/JPEG are separate interventions, not a continuous severity scale. Descriptive comparisons: JPEG encoding is origin-aligned; subjects are unverified. No confirmed origin effect.

Eight actual held-out cases from the handcrafted probe, selected for inspection rather than prevalence estimation. FP/FN/TP denote prediction against release-origin labels; two extreme H–C/PCA cases supplement errors. Each row includes the original with quadrant boundaries, actual quadrant pixels, cached FFT/Haar profiles and color/edge summaries. Full IDs, selection reasons and predictions are in error_gallery_cases.csv. Descriptive comparisons: JPEG encoding is origin-aligned; subjects are unverified. No confirmed origin effect.
